visual.description: Very dark teal-black used as the primary page and section background throughout the site.
Slightly lighter dark teal used for card and panel surfaces like the feature cards and FAQ items.
Deep dark teal-blue dominant tone of the hero section gradient background.
Deep warm red-maroon that forms the left side of the hero gradient, part of the immersive background image.
Mid-dark teal used in transitional section backgrounds like the 'See Opux in Action' and footer areas.
Muted rose-red used for the primary CTA button 'Get Started' and the highlighted pricing card action.
Pure white used for all major headings, hero title text, and nav logo.
Near-white light grey used for body paragraphs and supporting copy text.
Medium grey used for subdued UI elements, close/dismiss icons, and de-emphasized text.
Golden yellow used for the italic handwritten-style 'BUILD IT RIGHT' accent text in the hero.
Hot pink-red used as a contrasting color in the layered hero headline treatment.
Light grey-white used for 'Login' nav link text in both nav states.
The nav background remains consistently dark/transparent over the hero, matching the page background dark teal.
Subtle dark border/divider color used around FAQ accordion items and feature cards.
White background used for the non-highlighted 'One Shot' pricing card.
Dark warm brownish-red used as the background for the 'Most Popular' pricing card overlay.
Faint light grid line color used in the retro-grid terrain background texture throughout the site.
